content_summary.text: Bibliographic record: Journal of Public Economics 15(1), pages 59-85, February 1981, Elsevier; DOI 10.1016/0047-2727(81)90053-0; sole author Oded Hochman.

Hochman's reference list (Crossref deposit) includes Flatters et al. 1974 ('Public good, efficiency and regional fiscal equalization', JPubE 3, p.99) and Stiglitz 1977 ('The theory of local public goods'), plus Hochman's own 1977 'The behavior of municipal governments, land rents and optimal taxation in an economy with local public goods and external returns to scale'; Arnott-Stiglitz 1979 does not appear in the deposited list (Arnott 1980, JUE, does). So the paper is in the same literature, but whether it engages the 1979 result cannot be established from the metadata.
